tickets.title: Sonic children stop using the display-model budget and the job-directory windows
tickets.what: Open reviews (fable j5c4cb51dc2240e9f #4, carbon j91fa6e1950156406 #2, astra j89d7a94587dc0669 #1): ~51% of job dirs are sonic children. They take 52-59% of card sentences and kind/outcome labels although Home never draws them (src/collectors/job-sentences.ts:257-260, decision-labels.ts:81-91), so the text model sits at its 240/h cap; and they fill the newest-200/64 directory windows (thin-jobs.ts:693, control-radar.ts:139, project-board.ts:284) so Home/Control 'done today' and Project lookups drop most of the day's imp jobs. Skip workers with a parent in sentence/label/recommendation updates; bound the windows by top-level jobs (children follow their parent). Also find why ~84% of job-sentences.json entries have empty text (carbon suspects reasoning_effort sent to the Mistral endpoint or reasoning text not stripped, src/collectors/small-model.ts:218-232) and fix it, with backoff on deterministic 4xx.

acceptance.text: No sentence/label/recommendation request is made for a job with a parent (unit test)
Directory windows count top-level jobs; a day with 300 children still shows every top-level job in Control today and Home
Empty-sentence cause identified in the report and fixed; deterministic 4xx backs off
Panel cadence/perf unchanged (existing perf tests pass)

tickets.title: Claude CLI workers get the HUD worker tools loaded up front
tickets.what: Scans and fable's review: Claude Code workers see hud_report/hud_progress/hud_sonic/hud_ask/hud_lease as deferred tools; ToolSearch for them returned empty 19/19 times, workers then guessed arguments (invalid_arguments) and started ~0 sonic children vs 1.6-2.8 for pi. Find how the Claude worker launch (src/mcp/cli-worker-startup.ts, harness-cli) can make these tools always loaded (Claude settings/env for tool search, or MCP server config), apply it to Claude worker launches only, and verify with a real headless claude worker that the first turn lists the five tools.

acceptance.text: Report names the mechanism and its source (Claude docs/flags/env) and the change made
Live: a claude worker job's transcript shows the HUD worker tools available without a ToolSearch call
Owner's own Claude settings untouched

tickets.title: Ticket scan counts every feature and marks partial totals
tickets.what: Reviews: the ticket scan takes the newest 64 feature directories (src/collectors/project-board.ts:219-239) while this repo has 73+, so ticket meters undercount with no mark. Either scan all with a cheap stat-first pass or mark the total as partial; and $HUD_HOME/flows/ gets retention like jobs (no reader prunes it; 126 files in 1.5 days).

acceptance.text: With >64 features the meter is complete or visibly marked partial
flows/ older than the job retention window are pruned by the existing retention pass
Unit tests

tickets.title: A replayed land re-gates when the published code tree differs from the tested one
tickets.what: Astra review #2: hud_land can replay tested commits onto a newer base when paths are disjoint and fast-forward without a second gate (src/mcp/land-runner.ts:293-349); 33/116 attempts were replayed. Disjoint paths can still break (caller vs callee). Record the tested tree and the tree to publish; reuse green only for an identical tree or a ticket/STATE-metadata-only difference; otherwise re-run the gate once before fast-forward, and push the approved sha only.

acceptance.text: Flow receipt records tested_tree and published_tree
Replay with only metadata differences skips the gate; replay with a code difference re-gates
Push publishes exactly the gated sha
Unit tests with synthetic repos

tickets.title: Install upgrades dependencies on lockfile change and selective uninstall keeps shared commands
tickets.what: Reviews (carbon #9, astra #9): `install` runs `npm ci` only when node_modules is missing (install:64-75), so `git pull && ./install` keeps stale deps; selective uninstall unlinks core commands other extensions still use (install:48-59); re-running ./install without --with does a core-only build and leaves client integrations stale. Store the lockfile hash and run npm ci when it changes; keep core commands on selective uninstall; remember installed extensions in $HUD_HOME and upgrade them on a bare ./install.

acceptance.text: Changed package-lock.json triggers npm ci; unchanged does not
Uninstalling one extension leaves core commands and other extensions working
Bare ./install upgrades previously installed extensions
Installer tests cover the three cases
